# graphql-cost-limit

> Schema-aware cost and depth limits for GraphQL queries before execution: slicing-argument multipliers, fragment cycle detection and pre-parse nesting guards Python package `trysac-graphql-cost-limit`, import name `graphql_cost_limit`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
